h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bikaner

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bikaner

c: Bikaner lies in the Thar desert in north-west Rajasthan, and sand is part of daily life here in a way it is not in most Indian cities. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bikaner to schools, colleges, defence and government campuses, municipal gardens and residential colonies. We make the Fun Fitness range at our Vasai factory, about 960 km away, and deliver it by road.

Desert conditions test outdoor machines in three ways. Summer heat is extreme, winter nights are cold, and wind-blown sand gets into every gap. We use galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic parts, and the bearings are housed to keep sand out. Even so, sand will build up around footplates and pedals, so someone has to sweep the gym area often. Loose sand also makes a poor footing, so we grout machines into concrete on open ground.

items.q: How do outdoor gym machines handle sand in Bikaner?
items.a: The bearings are housed, which keeps most sand out. Sweep the base often and wipe the machines down so sand does not grind around footplates and pedals.

items.q: Can machines be installed on sandy ground?
items.a: Not directly on loose sand. We grout each post into a concrete footing, ideally on a paved base, so the machine stays firm and level.

items.q: Do you supply defence or government campuses in Rajasthan?
items.a: Yes. We work from the site size and photos, send a layout drawing with the clear zone marked, and quote. Installation is by our team or a dealer covering north India.
